title: Count whether the practice records earn their keep
why: Owner item 150 a: collect lessons by hand for two weeks, then count cites and repeats to decide on the full shivpedia plan.
note:
Collect: 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-20 CST, triage adds each lesson from a reviewer finding or an owner correction to decision test-practices (testing) or merge-practices (merging, draft PR #1320): a new practice line or an evidence bullet, with its source (repo, PR or item, and time).
Cites: count plans, briefs and reviewer reports that cite a practice id (P1-P11, M1-M7) or either record by name in that window (search/code and search/issues over claude-settings and the child repos).
Repeats: count incidents that repeat a practice already in a record at the time; each is a miss.
Decide: the counts go to the owner as one page item: start the full plan (draft PR #1034), keep the small form, or drop it.
